text: Yimɓe ɓen weeɓitee ka Joomi maa ko ɓe saffeeji O hasba ɓe, wi'anee ɓe: "Gmɗii on arii ka Amen gooto gooto holɓe soliiɓe wano Men tagirnoo on non ka laawol aranol, ko woni, on aaƴino wonnde onon on immintintaake, wonnde Menen Men waɗanaano on jamaanu e nokkuure nde Men yoɓata on e mu'un golleeji mo'on ɗin".
